memory.name: Memory
memory.pattern: Long dash when sharing a plot

latency.name: Latency

latency.pattern: Solid p50; long dash p95; dotted p99 when sharing a plot

neutral.name: Other measurements

comparison.name: Comparison
comparison.usage: Named previous period alongside a current series.

threshold.name: Threshold
threshold.usage: Explicit numeric limit. Health stays in separately labeled status indicators.

event.name: Deployment event
event.usage: Deployment annotation with a revision and timestamp.

compositionRules.navigation: The 52 px activity rail exclusively owns global destinations, Settings and Account on desktop. The second sidebar defaults to 224 px, resizes from 180 to 420 px while reserving 360 px for work, and remembers its width across views and reloads. Drag its divider, use Left/Right (Shift for larger steps), Home/End for limits, or double-click to reset. Each pane scrolls independently. The second sidebar owns context selection, local sections, filters, and settings categories. Resource lists, tables, and viewers belong entirely in the right work pane, including task lists and changed files. Omit generic cross-destination links and repeated horizontal or return navigation. On compact panes, open the current sidebar as a drawer with one global-navigation fallback. Computer navigation selects one mounted work-pane section at a time; preserve form values and expanded rows while switching.
compositionRules.location: The location bar names the current resource; the contextual sidebar owns local sections.
compositionRules.context: Task scope lives in a compact status bar. Additional source and execution details open on request in an accessible inspector dialog at every width.
compositionRules.density: Desktop navigation rows are 40 px; resource rows are at least 56 px with 13 px text. Use 24 px desktop / 16 px compact inner insets and 32 px between form sections. Touch targets are at least 44 px. Source, diffs and logs retain their own dense reading rhythm.
compositionRules.actions: Reserve strong emphasis for the next decision. Keep secondary actions quiet.
compositionRules.identity: Name resources in the location bar and sections in the contextual sidebar. Do not repeat them as page headings or add descriptive boilerplate.
compositionRules.files: Repository resources stay in the right work pane with 24 px desktop / 16 px compact inner insets. Use one resource header, a branch/history/file-finder toolbar, a latest-commit strip and a quietly bounded Name / Last commit / Updated / Size table. Render the committed README below the table with a readable prose width. History, commit diffs and source retain local scrolling; source offers preview, copy and download when actual content is available. Clone uses the authenticated hosted URL; new tasks pin the selected revision. Keep repository selection and local sections in the contextual sidebar.
compositionRules.workbenches: Resource lists, tables, conversations, code review, source and logs fill the right work pane. Use one 56 px location header, 24 px desktop / 16 px compact inner insets, generous resource rows and quiet separators. Review provides Changes and Checks views, real file navigation, and per-file old/new line gutters. Source, diff and log lines retain their own dense reading rhythm and local horizontal scrolling.
compositionRules.logs: Give logs the full work area. Show release once, scope in filters, and aligned timestamp, service, level and message columns.
compositionRules.chat: A task has one location header for its title and actions; project, execution computer and state live in a quiet context row. Transcript and continuation composer share readingWidth and the same content axis inside the work pane. Use a solid, quietly bordered prompt surface; keep prose readable, controls compact, and computer use separate from code review.
compositionRules.tasks: New tasks fill the right work pane with a bounded prompt on the same readingWidth axis as the conversation. Use Describe the work and put execution context adjacent to the prompt. Do not stretch an empty textarea to fill the window or repeat project descriptions. The second sidebar retains project scope and task sections; actual task lists stay in the right pane.
compositionRules.resources: Application overview and computer lists fill the work area. Use aligned resource rows, thin separators and expandable detail instead of inset cards. Show platform or scope once in the appropriate column or toolbar.
compositionRules.settings: Use readable property groups with 32 px between sections and 24 px desktop / 16 px compact insets. Align labels and controls without boxing every field into a grid. Preserve mounted form drafts and honest save state. Keep variable values masked and names inside a disclosure.
compositionRules.repository: Show repository linkage and its direct navigation action in application settings. Repository selection and Files/Issues/Pull requests belong in the repository sidebar; do not repeat those destinations as application tabs or related navigation groups.
compositionRules.repositoryWork: Issues and pull requests fill their pane with a fixed search/filter toolbar and aligned list rows. Titles appear once in expandable summaries; keep meaningful criteria, checks, file diffs and agent actions inside detail. No inset cards or generic descriptions.
compositionRules.overlays: Use one dialog title and omit repeated introductions. Dialogs have 24 px desktop / 16 px compact insets and fixed action footers; menus have 8 px insets and 38 px desktop / 44 px touch rows. Pickers use group labels rather than repeated titles. Anchor and clamp popovers to the work area. Only one picker opens at a time; arrows/Home/End navigate, Tab exits, Escape dismisses the top layer and restores focus. Keep source, permission scope, deployment impact and recovery explicit. Data inspection dialogs use the 880 px tableDialog token and keep a 720 px tableMinimum only when needed for column readability; compact screens scroll the table locally with keyboard access.
compositionRules.continuity: Use a shared 24 px desktop / 16 px phone content inset. Fit the preview workspace to the available viewport and show the simulation caption once. Carry the active task name through conversation, code review and release. Use the contextual sidebar for section changes and return navigation; avoid repeated back buttons and workflow strips. Analytics uses a flat two-column desktop grid and one column on compact panes.
compositionRules.rightPanes: Keep the work pane full-size with one 56 px toolbar, 24 px desktop / 16 px compact inner insets and 32 px between form sections. Resource lists use 13 px text, 56 px rows and subtle separators; headers are 44 px. Keep source and log density independent from resource density. Pin controls and status bars, preserve state and local reading positions, and activate resource rows across their full width.
compositionRules.keyboard: F6 and Shift+F6 move between the activity rail, context navigation, and the work pane, returning to the last focused resource. Up/Down/Home/End traverse navigation and resource lists; Enter/Space activate controls. Right/Left open and close disclosures; Right opens a selected folder and Alt+Up returns to its parent. In source viewers and consoles, unmodified arrows and Page Up/Down scroll content. Tab follows native control order. Compact navigation behaves as a modal drawer; Escape closes the top overlay and restores its trigger. Focus has a visible inset outline distinct from selection.
compositionRules.resourceState: Keep drafts, caret selections, selected files, project searches, repository sorting, open disclosures, and horizontal/vertical reading positions when switching resources during the session. Key state by resource and scope, never by DOM position. Preserve focus on initiating navigation and form controls after rerenders; restore the last work control when reentering a pane. Preference actions focus the active category, and restored reading positions never move the whole page.
compositionRules.feedback: Use one compact inline feedback row in the affected right pane: a 16 px icon, one short title, optional cause or preserved-work detail, and a specific recovery action. Use the shared 24 px desktop / 16 px compact inset and 32 px desktop / 44 px touch controls. Loading keeps navigation and drafts available, marks the pane busy, and offers Cancel for a long request. Empty search results clear filters; first-use states point to existing creation controls without duplicating toolbar actions. Errors use danger plus text and Retry or a concrete fix; pending decisions use warning. Preserve drafts, form values, selections, review state, and reading positions through recovery. Never convert missing telemetry to zero or healthy. Inline field errors stay attached to their input. Demo states live in the review bar, outside product navigation.
compositionRules.inputs: Use TextField from @/components/ui with the default bordered appearance for configuration and standalone forms. Use appearance="plain" inside an existing toolbar or row. Legacy inputs, textareas and input shells use data-appearance="plain". Plain entry is transparent, has zero enclosing border, radius, shadow, and inline padding, including hover. Focus uses the shared form.focusWidth underline in accent; invalid entry uses danger plus associated error text. Preserve labels, native editing, read-only selection, disabled semantics, and 44 px touch targets. Forced colors use a system-color bottom rule. Apply the shared appearance to task, computer, issue, pull request, log, and command searches; never replace them with per-view unboxed styles.
compositionRules.content: Every product label must name a modeled resource, state, scope, or working action. Omit invented networks, environments, backup policies, isolation/traffic guarantees, quotas, provider catalogs, capability claims, and success messages for operations that do not execute. Unknown values stay unavailable, never fabricated. Illustrative data belongs to the named design-system specimens, with one simulation caption; decorative context and toast-only product actions are omitted. Keep reference/history examples visibly separate from current behavior.
compositionRules.brand: Landing, documentation, authentication and workspace share the same solid violet action, quiet neutrals, typography and focus tokens. Metric and status colors retain their semantic roles. The landing page uses a floating dashboard launcher; dashboard routes use only the activity rail and contextual navigation.
compositionRules.selection: Use Select from @/components/ui for every single-value dropdown. Trigger, popup, options, selection, focus and disabled states share semantic tokens. Preserve native keyboard selection, type-ahead, form values and labels. Customizable-select browsers render the tokenized popup; other browsers retain their accessible operating-system picker with a themed trigger. Never hide a select under a competing imitation trigger.
compositionRules.motion: Motion explains a user action: 120 ms hover/press feedback, 180 ms state transitions, 220 ms overlay entry, 140 ms exit and 240 ms compact drawer entry. Use the shared easing, 4 px reveal / 12 px drawer travel and 0.98 press scale. Animate opacity and transform for overlay entry; never animate entire routes, streaming text, table rows, scrolling restoration or sidebar resizing. Reduced motion removes travel, scaling and continuous animation without delaying actions or focus. React overlays that unmount close immediately; never defer focus restoration for an exit animation.
compositionRules.dividers: Pane dividers are stationary neutral one-pixel boundaries, never accent-colored tracks or progress marks. Hover, dragging and keyboard focus reveal a small centered horizontal resize icon. Only its compact keyboard focus ring uses accent. Scrollable viewers use a dashed inset focus boundary, distinct from a solid scrollbar. Keep real scrollbars inside their scroll regions and resize without animation.
